name: revxl-marketplace
description: REVXL's curated catalog of Claude superengines — opinionated, multi-skill plugins built for real coaching businesses. One install, per-plugin picker, auto-updates.

plugins.name: workspace-superengine
plugins.description: Workspace lifecycle superengine v0.2. Scaffolds workspaces from shipped templates (15 artifacts, no model invention), then powers session-start / session-closeout against them. Built on agent-optimizer's four override constraints. Works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code.

plugins.name: ghl-coach-superengine
plugins.description: GoHighLevel done-with-you toolkit for health/wellness/fitness coaches. 8 skills + 2 agents that build and maintain a persistent 13-file per-coach workspace, refresh it from GHL on every session, surface what needs attention, and execute multi-step work via MCP. Requires the GoHighLevel-MCP (mastanley13) and Filesystem MCP.

plugins.name: revxl-os-superengine
plugins.description: Autonomous coaching ops superengine for Claude Code. Three agents (morning brief, task surfacing, DM triage) running on schedules and event triggers, delivered through Telegram. Pairs with revxl-webhook-channel for webhook-driven automation. The OpenClaw alternative built on native Claude Code Channels.
